title: getproperty billing
description: getproperty is free with no monthly fee. Here are the fees on payments the platform confirms, invoices from getproperty and the hardware at your buildings.

readOnly.title: Your account is read-only
readOnly.body: The subscription is suspended for an unpaid invoice ({count, plural, one {# open} other {# open}}). Pay it with the Thai QR below; the account reopens once getproperty confirms the payment.

pastDue.title: Payment overdue
pastDue.body: An invoice from getproperty is overdue since {date}. Pay it to avoid suspension.

trial.title: Free trial
trial.body: The trial ends on {date}; the first invoice follows.

noneHint: A fee applies only to payments the platform confirms, summed on a monthly invoice below.
estimateHint: From what is counted so far; the invoice follows at the end of the month.
invoicesHint: Pay each one with its Thai QR; the PDF is the tax invoice.
usageHint: What was counted each month and charged for it.
hardwareHint: Platform devices rented at your buildings.
surveysHint: Upgrading to Smart starts with a survey of the building.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Apartment Smart
upgrade.hint: Smart meters read themselves. A field engineer first surveys one building (meters, network, power) and proposes the installation; your plan changes once it is installed.
upgrade.notesHint: Access, best days, contact on site

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Every file and record of this account, counted at the file's real size and a standard size per record.

files.title: Largest files
files.description: Select files you no longer need to delete them. Deleted files can be restored until they are removed for good. Legal documents and evidence cannot be deleted.
files.selectAll: Select every deletable file on this page
files.deleteBody: The selected files move to "Deleted files". They still count and can be restored until they are removed for good; then the space is freed.
files.deleted: Deleted — restorable until removed for good

empty.deleted: No files waiting to be removed

files.heldOpen: Kept until its period after the lease ends

storage.filesHint: Meter photos, slips, repair photos, contracts and uploads

note.unmetered: Storage has no limit at the moment; keep working as usual.
note.safe: Your data is never deleted or locked, even when storage is full. Documents the law requires, such as receipts and leases, are always produced.
note.full: Everything you stored stays. Documents the law requires are produced as usual; only some optional uploads wait until you remove files you no longer need or add space.
note.billed: Extra storage is {price} per GB per month, on your monthly getproperty invoice. All your data stays.

legalHold.title: Documents the law requires you to keep: {bytes}
legalHold.body: Leases, receipts, tax invoices and payment slips count towards your storage and cannot be deleted until their legal retention period ends. They are always produced, even when storage is full.

storage.pendingPurge: {bytes} waiting to be removed for good. It still counts until then and can be restored before that day.

warning.title: Storage almost full ({percent}% used)
warning.body: Delete files you no longer need or add space with a package. Your data and legal documents are not affected.

full.title: Storage full ({percent}% used)
full.body: Some optional uploads wait until you free space or add a package. Everything you stored stays; receipts and legal documents are produced as usual.

page.title: Storage
page.description: See where the space goes, free space from files you no longer need, or add space with a package.

packages.title: Storage packages
packages.description: Package space adds to your free allowance. Nothing is deleted when a package ends.
packages.noOffersHint: Free space by deleting files you no longer need below.
packages.unpricedHint: No price has been set yet. Meanwhile, free space by deleting files you no longer need.
packages.buyBody: Adds {size} {period} for {total} incl. VAT. getproperty issues an invoice and the package starts on the day it is paid. If it is not paid the package simply does not start — nothing is suspended.
packages.autoRenewHint: Invoice the next period before the package ends
packages.bought: Ordered — pay the invoice to start the package
packages.waiting: Starts when the invoice is paid
